criteria.name: nll.delta
criteria.rule: |mean NLL - ref| <= max(3 * sigma, 0.005) nats/token; sigma = ref rerun |delta|

criteria.name: nll.top1_rerun
criteria.rule: top-1 agreement >= ref rerun top-1 agreement - 0.5 points

criteria.name: greedy.hazard
criteria.rule: golden divergence hazard <= 2 * max(ref A/A hazard, 0.005)

criteria.name: kwargs.core
criteria.rule: the 10 kwarg-matrix cells other than thinking:true pass

criteria.name: kwargs.thinking_alias
criteria.rule: both thinking:true cells pass (known FAIL until the QUAL-2 template alias)

criteria.name: utf8
criteria.rule: zero U+FFFD, rows 1..40 present, every n^2 right, finish_reason stop

criteria.name: vision
criteria.rule: every vision check passes (video may SKIP)

criteria.name: tools.json_valid
criteria.rule: tool-call JSON-valid rate >= 0.98 over 50 calls (a missing call counts as invalid)

verdict: FAIL tier0 compare vs nvidia-v11-k7: 9/10 criteria; failed vision
